turns.speaker: JAMIE
turns.text: I want to ask the question that's probably on a few minds. These are balloons collecting data. What kind of data are we talking about?

turns.speaker: ALEX
turns.text: The reporting specifies atmospheric data. WindBorne's product is weather balloon technology. This isn't a surveillance contract, based on what TechCrunch reported.

turns.speaker: JAMIE
turns.text: I appreciate the precision. Because "balloon data collection" in a defense contract lands differently in 2026 than it would have three years ago.

turns.speaker: RUFUS
turns.text: Context being the Chinese balloon incident that became a significant diplomatic event in 2023. High-altitude balloon programs and their data collection capabilities are no longer a niche topic.
